kind: Summaries of actual rehearsal failures; no model interaction

failures.observation: Direct reference queries succeeded; provider initialization rejected the database because APOC meta was not installed.
failures.resolution: Install APOC 5.26.0 matching Neo4j 5.26.0 and restart.

failures.observation: Connection and discovery succeeded after plugin installation, but get-schema returned isError=true: apoc.meta.schema was sandboxed.
failures.resolution: Permit apoc.meta.* for the trusted plugin in the disposable instance and restart.
